# exo_journal_rule (Resource)

Manages the JournalRule object via New-JournalRule / Get-JournalRule / Set-JournalRule / Remove-JournalRule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `journal_email_address` (String) Maps to the -JournalEmailAddress parameter.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `recipient` (String) Maps to the -Recipient parameter.
- `scope` (String) Maps to the -Scope parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
